description:
The K-Uno has been developed for riders seeking a bicycle that combines performance, comfort, and versatility in equal measure. Designed as a modern endurance road frameset, the K-Uno delivers the efficiency and responsiveness expected from a performance road bike whilst offering the comfort and capability required for long rides and varied road conditions.

Constructed from a blend of premium Toray T800 and T1000 carbon fibres, the K-Uno is manufactured using our advanced true one-piece monocoque moulding process. This manufacturing method allows precise control of fibre orientation and carbon lay-up throughout the frame, creating an optimised balance of stiffness, durability, compliance, and weight.

At the heart of the K-Uno's design is the belief that endurance riding should not come at the expense of performance. The frame combines a compact and efficient structure with carefully integrated aerodynamic features, helping riders maintain speed and efficiency whilst benefiting from enhanced comfort over long distances.

The K-Uno incorporates an FSA integrated headset system with full internal cable routing, allowing brake hoses and electronic wiring to pass cleanly through the cockpit and frame. This modern integration improves aerodynamic efficiency, protects cables from the elements, and contributes to the bicycle's clean and uncluttered appearance.

Designed for the demands of modern road cycling, the K-Uno offers clearance for tyres up to 35 mm. This increased capacity allows riders to benefit from improved comfort, grip, and confidence across a wide variety of road conditions whilst retaining the responsive handling characteristics expected from a high-performance road bike. The additional clearance also provides the flexibility to comfortably tackle occasional light gravel sections when the route demands it.

A T47 threaded bottom bracket provides excellent bearing support and efficient power transfer whilst combining the reliability and ease of maintenance associated with threaded systems.

The K-Uno balances lightweight construction with the strength and durability required for year-round riding. The result is a highly versatile endurance road frameset equally suited to long-distance training rides, Gran Fondos, sportive events, mountainous terrain, and everyday road riding.

Fully compliant with current UCI regulations, the K-Uno represents KUOTA's modern interpretation of the endurance road bike, combining comfort, versatility, aerodynamic efficiency, and performance in a single integrated package.
